script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

EXT. SUNNYFIELD - DAY

Small, idyllic town nestled in rolling hills and lush greenery. The sun bathes the town in warmth. The bustle of everyday life fills the air.

INT. POST OFFICE - DAY

MRS. SIMPSON (60s, kind-faced, red apron) sits behind the counter, sorting mail. JIMMY (30s, wide-eyed, mop of curly hair) enters, breathless.

JIMMY
Morning, Mrs. Simpson! I made it!

MRS. SIMPSON
(smiling)
Yes, Jimmy, you did. What brings you to the post office so early?

JIMMY
(grinning)
The town contest! I'm entering my secret chili recipe in the Sunnyfield Chili Cook-Off!

MRS. SIMPSON
(laughs)
Ah, Jimmy, you and your chili! Best of luck to you.

---

EXT. JIMMY'S HOUSE - DAY

Jimmy rides his bike up to his house, where his MOTHER (50s, stern, caring) greets him at the door.

MOTHER
Jimmy, I've got some news for you. Your father's older brother, Uncle Joe, is coming to town. He hasn't been here in decades.

JIMMY
(surprised)
Really? That's fantastic! I'll help you prepare for his arrival.

---

EXT. SUNNYFIELD HIGH SCHOOL - DAY

At school, JIMMY's best friend, FRANK (30s, tall, bald, jovial), sits at a picnic table eating lunch with JIMMY.

FRANK
So, Jimmy, you're really entering that chili cook-off, huh?

JIMMY
(excited)
Absolutely! I've got a secret recipe that's gonna knock their socks off.

FRANK
Well, I've got some news too, buddy. I'm entering the Sunnyfield Pie-Baking Contest with a recipe of my own.

JIMMY
(laughs)
You and your pies! Alright, we've got some competition brewing here, haven't we?

---

EXT. SUNNYFIELD - DAY

Jimmy and Frank go about their preparations, working in their gardens and gathering ingredients. They pass each other on the street, exchanging knowing smiles.

---

INT. JIMMY'S HOUSE - NIGHT

Jimmy and Mother sit at the dining room table, going over the chili recipe. Uncle Joe enters, carrying a duffle bag.

UNCLE JOE (70s, weathered, grizzled)
(surprised)
Well, well, what a nice surprise! It's been a long time since I've been back to this place.

JIMMY
(excited)
Uncle Joe! We're so glad you're here!

---

EXT. SUNNYFIELD FAIRGROUNDS - DAY

The Sunnyfield Fair is in full swing, with various booths, games, and attractions. The Chili Cook-Off and Pie-Baking Contest tents are busy with entrants preparing their dishes.

INT. CHILI COOK-OFF TENT - DAY

Jimmy works feverishly over his chili pot, while Frank works on his pie next door in the Pie-Baking Tent. They exchange knowing glances as they hear the judges' voices growing louder.

---

EXT. SUNNYFIELD FAIRGROUNDS - EVENING

The sun begins to set, and the fairgoers start to trickle out. Jimmy and Frank stand outside the tents, waiting anxiously for the contest results.

ANNOUNCER (40s, suave, microphone) appears and calls the entrants forward. Jimmy and Frank share an apprehensive look.

---

EXT. SUNNYFIELD FAIRGROUNDS - NIGHT

The results are announced: Jimmy and Frank have tied for first place! They share a moment of triumph, then agree to split the prize money.

---

INT. JIMMY'S HOUSE - NIGHT

Jimmy and Frank sit in Jimmy's living room, both holding their half of the prize money.

FRANK
You know, Jimmy, we could've just split the ingredients and save ourselves some trouble.

JIMMY
(smiling)
But where's the fun in that? Besides, it was a friendly competition. We can't let it end like that.

FRANK
(laughs)
Agreed. I think I'll use my half to enter next year's beer-brewing contest.

JIMMY
(grinning)
Beat you to it! I'll start working on my beer recipe tonight!

They share a hearty laugh as the screen fades to black.

FADE OUT.

---

END OF SCREENPLAY.
